title: Sukko
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Dāruno bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || 3 Lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtassa pariyādiṇṇa-cittassa bhikkhave Devadattassa sukko dhammo samucchedam agamā || || 4 Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || 5 Sikkhitabbanti || || Catutthaṃ || || [page 241] XVII. 35. 10] CATUTTHO VAGGO 241
